Unified publications

Compare PubMed (synced cache) and Scholar BibTeX in one table sorted by year (newest first), then author. The Source column shows whether each row is from PubMed, Scholar, or both. The PubMed PMID is the canonical id when the same paper appears twice. Duplicate links and Scholar exclusions live in this browser only—use Export browser state to save a JSON snapshot. PubMed “Exclude” uses the same storage as PubMed bibliography.

PubMed synced: 2026-03-31T15:09:59Z · (Gutman DA[Author] OR Gutman David A[Author]) · 97 articles · 258 Scholar entries

Copied unified state JSON to clipboard.

How to flag duplicates

  1. The Source column labels each row: Both, PubMed, or Scholar. “Both” means Scholar already matches this PMID (URL/title in the .bib or a link you saved).
  2. Ignore Both is on by default so already-matched rows are hidden; uncheck the box to see them again. When on, you only see PubMed-only and Scholar-only (discrepancies).
  3. Sort is shared, so PubMed and Scholar rows for the same paper often appear near each other—use find-in-page on the title if needed.
  4. To link manually: on PubMed, paste the Scholar citation key (e.g. cooper2010integrative) and click Link. Or on Scholar, paste the PMID and click Link.
  5. Saved pairs are listed under Duplicate links you saved. Unlink if you made a mistake. PubMed stays the canonical row.
